name: SQL Injection in Login Form
description: Unsanitized input in the payment gateway login form allows SQL injection, potentially exposing transaction data.

name: Outdated TLS Configuration
description: Payment Gateway API still accepts TLS 1.0/1.1, allowing downgrade attacks on data in transit.

name: Missing MFA on Admin Accounts
description: Privileged administrator accounts on the Banking Server do not require multi-factor authentication.

name: Unpatched Operating System
description: Banking Server is running an OS build missing critical security patches (simulated CVE-2024-SYNTH-01).

name: Weak Database Credentials
description: Customer Database uses default/weak service account credentials for administrative access.

name: Unencrypted Data at Rest
description: Sensitive customer records are stored without disk-level or field-level encryption.

name: Phishing-Susceptible Email Gateway
description: Email gateway lacks advanced phishing/attachment sandboxing, increasing credential theft risk.

name: Outdated Email Server Software
description: Mail server software is two major versions behind vendor security updates.

name: Excessive Cloud Storage Bucket Permissions
description: Cloud File Storage buckets are configured with overly broad read/write permissions.

name: Outdated CMS Plugins
description: Corporate Website CMS plugins have known unpatched vulnerabilities.

name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
description: Reflected XSS vulnerability found in the website's search and contact forms.

name: Legacy Authentication Protocol
description: Internal ERP System still supports a legacy, unencrypted authentication protocol.

name: Unrestricted VPN Split Tunneling
description: VPN Gateway allows split tunneling, letting remote traffic bypass corporate security controls.

name: Default Router Credentials
description: Branch Office Router is still using vendor default administrative credentials.

name: Missing Endpoint Detection & Response
description: Employee Laptop Fleet has no EDR agent deployed, delaying detection of malware/ransomware.

name: Untested Backup Restore Process
description: Backup & DR Server's restore procedure has not been tested in the last 12 months.
